profile.summary: Millennium Consulting, also called Millennium Consulting Associates, is a California consulting firm that has provided environmental engineering, industrial hygiene and building science services since 1998. Its work includes hazardous materials testing and management for K-12 and higher education facilities, including bond-funded modernization projects.
